texts.zh:
你正在干预超出你们理解的力量！

你们在建的这些令人憎恶的“虚境封印”简直难以忍受，即便距离如此之远。你将星系中最闪耀的意识置于危险的净地。立刻停止建造，否则我们不会再与你做任何交易了。
texts.en:
You are meddling with forces beyond your comprehension!

These 'Shroud Seal' abominations you are constructing are painful to endure, even at this distance. You place the most radiant minds in this galaxy at risk. Cease their creation immediately, or we will have no further dealings with you.
